method: Translate each complete clamp, including its two bolts, along the straight handlebar only. Retain the tube, upper plate, eight meshes, UVs, normals, materials and all other poses. The 38.5 mm station lies near the existing plate apertures while retaining 0.5 mm nominal coverage beyond the existing 12 mm knurled bands inside each 26 mm saddle.
checks_required: Native evaluated triangle intersections before and after between each lower saddle/stud and the unchanged plate
Exported plate sampled across the full 10 mm stud diameter, not just its centreline
Binary GLB payload unchanged; exactly eight translations changed in both isolated and full LOD candidates
Native source translations agree with the full LOD candidate; original files retain their hashes
Real Babylon close views and whole-bike view, desktop and narrow viewport
not_resolved: Exact RDC component pairing, measured dimensions and true installed orientation
Vertical engagement, damper compression, washer/nut stack and preload
Control M6 bolt versus 4.3 mm bore
Side-stand 12 mm shoulder versus 9 mm eye
Six-hole sprocket versus four-hole carrier and final-drive chain
Cable endpoints, complete hose routes and steering slack
